name: 337. Gemini and Vertex chat and Responses report document and tool-prompt tokens; Vertex delivers or refuses service_tier and forwards URLs (google chat usage)
description: Pins contract C4 and C5 for Google chat. (1) Usage: every modality Gemini bills in usageMetadata.promptTokensDetails reaches usage.prompt_tokens_details under its own field (VIDEO as video_tokens, DOCUMENT as document_tokens; both were dropped), and usageMetadata.toolUsePromptTokenCount reaches usage.tool_use_prompt_tokens (it was not mapped). The cases compare the unified usage with the vendor's own numbers in extra_fields.raw_response, so they hold for whatever the vendor reports. (2) service_tier on Vertex travels as the X-Vertex-AI-LLM-Shared-Request-Type header. A tier that cannot be sent used to be dropped silently and the request billed at the standard tier; it is now 400 caller_unsupported_parameter with error.param service_tier, before any upstream call, on chat, streamed chat, Responses and streamed Responses. default asks for standard processing and is accepted. (3) An https image URL on a Vertex Gemini request is sent as fileData.fileUri; Bifrost used to download it and send inlineData. (4) The same usage fields and URL forwarding are pinned on /v1/responses (input_tokens_details, tool_use_prompt_tokens) and on the streamed chat and Responses routes, where a PDF prompt must produce a usage frame that names document_tokens. A blocked prompt or output (native_finish_reason next to finish_reason content_filter) cannot be triggered deterministically by a live request and is pinned by unit tests only.
